The Hebrew letter **vav** (**ו** ) is the sixth letter of the [Hebrew alphabet](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Vav/vav.html) and carries a numerical value of **6**.[[1]](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Vav/vav.html)[[2]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137078/jewish/Vav.htm)

### Basic Features

- **Shape and Meaning:** It looks like a single vertical line or peg, and its literal meaning is a **"hook," "nail," or "tent peg"**.
- **Pronunciation:** In Modern Hebrew, it is usually pronounced as a **"v"** sound. Historically, it sounded like a **"w"**.
- **As a Vowel:** With dots added above or inside, it can function as a vowel sound for **"o"** (ḥolam male) or **"u"** (shuruk).[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waw)[[2]](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Vav/vav.html)[[3]](https://gabrielelevy.com/pages/the-letter-vav)[[4]](https://ephraimintheland.wordpress.com/2018/01/20/vav/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DE6FXz8Qo9w&t=5)[[6]](https://hebrewtoday.com/alphabet/the-letter-vav-%D7%95/)

### Grammatical Uses

- **Conjunction ("And"):** Placed as a prefix at the start of a word (*vav conjunctive* ), it means "and" (e.g., connecting ideas, people, or events).
- **Tense Changer:** Known as the *vav consecutive* , it can flip the tense of a verb from past to future or future to past in biblical Hebrew.[[1]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137078/jewish/Vav.htm)[[2]](https://ephraimintheland.wordpress.com/2018/01/20/vav/)[[3]](https://inner.org/hebleter/vav.htm)

### Symbolism

- **Connection:** As a hook, it physically and spiritually connects heaven and earth, or joins separate parts of creation together.
- **Man and Creation:** Because it represents the number 6, it symbolizes man (created on the sixth day) and the six physical spatial directions (up, down, left, right, front, back).[[1]](https://gabrielelevy.com/pages/the-letter-vav)[[2]](https://www.hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Vav/vav.html)[[3]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137078/jewish/Vav.htm)[[4]](https://inner.org/hebleter/vav.htm)[[5]](https://ephraimintheland.wordpress.com/2018/01/20/vav/)
